description: This file contains a PHP class 'Gdpr' that manages GDPR-related database operations within an OpenCart project, such as adding records, updating status, and retrieving GDPR data.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: A model class for handling GDPR record database operations in the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: addGdpr
methods.description: Creates a new GDPR record in the database with provided code, email, and action.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing GDPR record identified by its ID.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its ID.

methods.name: getGdprByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its unique code.

methods.name: getGdprsByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves all GDPR records associated with a specific email.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves GDPR records with status 'processing' that are due to expire based on the configured limit.
